proposals.before: In Wang Mang's time he did not lose the noble; in the Jianwu years he passed through offices to grand minister of works, again enfeoffing a separate village of Fuping as Marquis of Wushi.
proposals.after: In Wang Mang's time he did not lose his noble title; in the Jianwu years he passed through offices to grand minister of works, and was again enfeoffed with a separate village of Fuping as Marquis of Wushi.
proposals.reason: 『不失爵』 means he did not lose his noble title/marquisate; 'the noble' is incomplete English, and the enfeoffment clause needs a passive subject matching the Chinese.

decisions.reason: s0191 不失爵 means he did not lose his noble title; bare “the noble” is incomplete. 更封富平之別鄉為武始侯 is a passive re-enfeoffment of the subject as Marquis of Wushi, not him actively enfeoffing; the proposed literal restores both.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 王莽時不失爵……更封富平之別鄉為武始侯
